archetype.description: Project-defined grouping for this character — role, class, species, rank, whatever axis the project sorts its cast by. Free-form on purpose: the taxonomy is per-project, not a Parlance concept. Drives the editor's group-by-archetype view.

dialogueStyle.description: Notes on how they speak — vocabulary, cadence, tics.

stats.description: Optional NPC stats keyed by skill id (for opposed checks later).

dialogues.description: Ordered dialogue ladder (first-match-wins). Resolution walks top-to-bottom and returns the first rung whose showIf passes; an absent showIf always matches (unconditional fallthrough). ARRAY ORDER IS SIGNIFICANT. Replaces the old defaultDialogue field.

dialogue.description: Dialogue id presented when this rung wins.

showIf.description: Gate for this rung. Omitted = always matches (fallthrough). By convention the last rung omits it.
